copy.html: You spend much of your week guiding, responding, and caring. Here, you are warmly encouraged to receive alongside your people—to pray, listen, laugh, and enjoy being together. Share at your own pace. We guide the session and agree on practical responsibilities beforehand.

copy.html: Discover a shared language

copy.html: Practice a simple prayer rhythm or listening tool together. You can return to it in staff meetings, small groups, and everyday care.

copy.html: Receive as a community

copy.label: Let someone else guide the flow. Give your people—and yourself—space for reflection,
copy.html: Let someone else guide the flow. Give your people—and yourself—space for reflection, encouragement, and connection.

copy.label: Trust grows when there is room to be human.
copy.html: Trust grows when there is room to be human.

copy.label: Even in a caring community, busy weeks can leave little room to know one another beyo
copy.html: Even in a caring community, busy weeks can leave little room to know one another beyond our roles.

copy.label: Shared prayer and attentive listening create space for a new conversation, a freely c
copy.html: Shared prayer and attentive listening create space for a new conversation, a freely chosen honest moment, and the experience of being heard. These small encounters can help trust take root.

copy.label: An invitation, never a demand.
copy.html: An invitation, never a demand.

copy.label: People choose what they share. Leaders are encouraged to model curiosity and respect
copy.html: People choose what they share. Leaders are encouraged to model curiosity and respect without asking others to disclose personal experiences.

copy.label: We agree on respectful listening and privacy expectations together. Passing or reflec
copy.html: We agree on respectful listening and privacy expectations together. Passing or reflecting quietly is always welcome.

copy.html: Patrick Lencioni places vulnerability-based trust at the foundation of his model in The Five Dysfunctions of a Team. Homeward makes space to practice listening, openness, and care that can support trust.
